# CSD-NNN — Task and verification record

## Assignments

| Task                 | Dependency | Owned files | Acceptance/checks                   | State   | Commit/evidence |
| -------------------- | ---------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- | --------------- |
| T00: verify baseline | None       | Name files  | Name observable result and commands | Pending | Not run         |

Use Pending, In progress, Implemented locally, Merged, or Blocked. Only name a landed commit after
it exists. Independent tasks must not overwrite each other's files. Use the prompt template for
each assignment; read the latest evidence before dispatching the next one.

## Verification entries

- Date / revision / dirty-tree scope:
- Command and actual result:
- Requirement IDs and evidence reference:
- Failures, pending checks and next action:

Keep CI, local, staging and recovery evidence distinct. Record a failed experiment before revising
its thresholds or design. Update the handoff when a session ends.
